capture.comment: The initial full-course sweep rendered all views and produced all chapter-IV captures, but failed on label placement in 252 part 2 step-5 at width 320. This record does not call that run passed.

resolution.description: The final view retains ABC, O and M with AM, the right-angle marker and equal BM/MC marks. Earlier P/Q auxiliary segments are absent from this final summary view.
